root_idea.summary: The root centers on greatness joined with antiquity or inherited distinction, giving rise to glorying, boasting, excellence, and marked largeness.
root_idea.development: Boasting is explained as recounting ancient or inherited distinction and claiming superiority. Related Classical usages extend the idea to excellent quality, bodily or organic largeness, and a few specialized applications; فَخَّارٌ ‘pottery’ is treated as an exceptional branch outside the central root principle.

senses.definition: Habitually boastful; given to magnifying oneself by boasting of possessions, status, lineage, qualities, or achievements.
senses.usage_conditions: An adjective describing a person characterized by repeated or excessive boasting and self-exaltation.

senses.definition: Baked or fired clay; pottery or earthen vessels made from it.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression كَالْفَخَّارِ, the word denotes fired pottery or fired clay, in contrast with clay before firing.

senses.definition: Mutual boasting; competing with one another for superiority through claims of glory, status, lineage, qualities, or other grounds of pride.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal or collective construction describing parties who boast against or vie with one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To glory in or boast of qualities, deeds, ancestry, possessions, or rank; to arrogate greatness; to contend with or excel another on such grounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِ for the thing or quality boasted of and with عَلَى for boasting against or claiming superiority over another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disdain or scorn.
To vie or compete with another for superiority in glory, boasting, excellence, or nobility, and to surpass the other in that contest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The contest may concern boasting generally or the nobility and generosity of one's parentage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To judge or make someone to excel another in glory, boasting, or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with عَلَى for the person over whom superiority is judged or established.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to bring forth offspring of excellent or goodly quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a specialized usage concerning childbirth and the quality of the offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To magnify oneself; to become proud, haughty, or disdainful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A self-directed or inchoative expression of pride and self-exaltation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of herbs, to become tall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative or tropical application, retained as a specialized Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To buy a garment, cloth, or other thing of excellent quality; also to use such a relation in connection with marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In marriage usage, the evidence specifies giving in marriage and apparently also taking in marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Glory or excellence; also a disposition or occasion for boasting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote the quality itself or, in context, the tendency to boast of it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thickness of an udder with contracted teat openings and little milk.
A manner or instance of glorying or boasting.
Of a she-camel, ewe, or she-goat: having a large udder with contracted teat openings and little milk, or yielding all the milk it has with none remaining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of female livestock and their udder or milk yield.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree, large in trunk and thick in its branches.
Of a horse, or of a man, large in the yard and long therein; of a penis, large.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical or bodily description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who vies, competes, or contends with another in glorying or boasting, especially in claims of nobility or superiority.
One overcome in a contest of boasting or glorying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A resultative or passive application of the same boasting contest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who glories or boasts much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for a person characterized by abundant boasting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good, goodly, superb, or excellent; of excellent quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing or anything of notably high quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of unripe dates: large and without stones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of dates, explained figuratively as seeming to boast over others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of sweet-smelling plant, identified in one usage with الريحان and in another with a broad-leaved marum.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical term with variant identifications in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing in which one glories or boasts; a cause of boasting, such as a generous quality or action inherited through generations.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for an inherited noble quality or memorable action; plural مَفَاخِرُ.

cautions: The Quranic adjective فَخُورٌ, the verbal noun تَفَاخُرٌ, and the pottery noun فَخَّارٌ are kept as distinct forms; the pottery sense is not derived from the Quranic meaning of boastfulness.
